name: Riyadh Office Relocation – انتقال مكتب الرياض

children.name: Kick-off & relocation plan sign-off – اجتماع الانطلاق واعتماد خطة الانتقال
children.notes: Confirm scope, budget, move date (Fri 4 – Sat 5 Dec 2026) and owners with Sara and Khalid.

children.name: Inventory of furniture, equipment & files – جرد الأثاث والمعدات والملفات
children.notes: Room-by-room list; mark what moves, what is disposed of, what is bought new.

children.name: Select & contract the moving company – اختيار شركة النقل والتعاقد معها
children.notes: Three quotes, site visits to both buildings, insurance cover, signed contract.

children.name: New building readiness check (power, access, fit-out) – فحص جاهزية المبنى الجديد
children.notes: Walk-through with building management: power, AC, lighting, doors/access control, server room, cabling routes.

children.name: Internet & network installation at the new building – تركيب الإنترنت والشبكة في المبنى الجديد
children.notes: ISP order and activation, structured cabling, switches, Wi-Fi, printers and phones.

children.name: Order packing materials & labels – طلب مواد التغليف والملصقات
children.notes: Quantities from the inventory; colour-coded labels per team/room.

children.name: Floor plan & seating allocation – مخطط الطوابق وتوزيع المقاعد
children.notes: Desk-by-desk plan for the new building; label codes match the packing labels.

children.name: Moving-day schedule & packing plan with the movers – جدول يوم النقل وخطة التغليف مع شركة النقل
children.notes: Truck timings, lift bookings at both buildings, crew size, fragile/IT handling, contact list.

children.name: Access badges, parking & security at the new building – تصاريح الدخول والمواقف والأمن في المبنى الجديد
children.notes: Badge list for all staff, parking allocation, keys for the moving crew on the weekend.

children.name: Notify staff, clients & suppliers; update address records – إبلاغ الموظفين والعملاء والموردين وتحديث بيانات العنوان
children.notes: Staff briefing, client/supplier notice, bank, commercial registration, Google Maps, website, stationery.

children.name: Old-office exit: utilities notices & lease handback checklist – إشعارات فصل الخدمات وقائمة تسليم المكتب القديم
children.notes: Electricity, water, internet disconnection dates; landlord inspection date; meter readings.

children.name: Data backup & IT shutdown plan – النسخ الاحتياطي للبيانات وخطة إيقاف الأنظمة
children.notes: Full backup verified off-site; shutdown/restart order for servers, network and workstations.

children.name: Final packing & labelling of desks and files – التغليف النهائي ووضع الملصقات
children.notes: Everyone packs their own desk; shared areas and archives packed by the team; IT equipment powered down at 17:00.

children.name: Ready to move – جاهزون للانتقال
Disconnect, load & transport to the new building – الفك والتحميل والنقل إلى المبنى الجديد
children.notes: Friday: movers dismantle and load at the old office; Anas supervises and signs the inventory sheet.

children.name: Unload & place furniture per floor plan – التفريغ وتوزيع الأثاث حسب المخطط
children.notes: Saturday: boxes and furniture to the labelled positions; Sara checks against the floor plan.

children.name: Reinstall IT equipment & test the network – إعادة تركيب أجهزة تقنية المعلومات واختبار الشبكة
children.notes: Saturday: server room, switches, Wi-Fi, printers, phones; test internet and shared drives before Sunday.

children.name: Old office final clean-up & key handover – التنظيف النهائي وتسليم مفاتيح المكتب القديم
children.notes: Saturday morning: final sweep, photos, meter readings, keys to the landlord.

children.name: Move complete – اكتمال النقل

tasks.name: Settling in – الاستقرار في المكتب الجديد

children.name: Unpack & set up workstations – فك التغليف وتجهيز محطات العمل
children.notes: Sunday–Monday: staff unpack their own desks; shared areas, kitchen and meeting rooms set up by the team.

children.name: IT support & snag fixing (network, printers, phones) – الدعم التقني ومعالجة ملاحظات الأنظمة
children.notes: First-week support desk; fix connectivity, printing and telephony issues as staff settle in.

children.name: Staff orientation & safety briefing at the new building – تعريف الموظفين بالمبنى وإحاطة السلامة
children.notes: Tour, emergency exits, fire assembly point, access rules, parking, facilities contacts.

children.name: Building snag list & fixes with facilities – قائمة الملاحظات وإصلاحها مع إدارة المبنى
children.notes: Collect issues from staff (AC, lighting, doors, furniture damage) and close them with building management and the movers' insurance.

children.name: Return packing materials & close the movers' contract – إعادة مواد التغليف وإقفال عقد شركة النقل
children.notes: Collect empty boxes/crates, sign off the damage report, approve the final invoice.

children.name: Close the old office: final bills, deposit & records update – إقفال المكتب القديم: الفواتير النهائية والتأمين وتحديث السجلات
children.notes: Final utility bills, deposit refund, remaining address changes, archive the old-office documents.

children.name: Post-move review & lessons learned – مراجعة ما بعد الانتقال والدروس المستفادة
children.notes: What went well, what to fix, budget vs. actual, closing the relocation project.

children.name: Relocation complete – اكتمال الانتقال
